source: FY2025 and FY2024 from Express Kenya Plc audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (extract); FY2023 and FY2022 from kenyanstocks.com financial statements API
source_note: FY2025 column transcribed from the audited extract for the year ended 31 December 2025 (Shs'000 in the source, stored here in KES). Every subtotal ties: Revenue 21,265 less direct costs 100,179 = gross loss 78,914; gross loss less administration 14,872 less other operating expenses 11,424 plus other operating income and impairment reversals 1,098 = operating loss 104,112; operating loss less finance costs 51,566 = loss before tax 155,678; loss before tax plus tax credit 30,659 = loss for the year 125,019; loss per share 2.62 on 47,711,000 shares. The source extract did not print the FY2025 split between other operating income and impairment reversal, so those two rows are left empty for FY2025. Gross Profit, Cost of Sales, Operating Profit (EBIT), Gross Margin and Operating Margin were also recomputed for the earlier years by identity from the rows already in the file; that identity reproduces the audited FY2024 figures (gross loss 71,465, operating loss 95,831) exactly. Ratios use the audited 31 December 2025 balance sheet (total assets 1,468,971, total liabilities 996,787, total equity 472,184).
